subject: Quick sync: usage uptick + 20-minute live walkthrough
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Katie Reynolds <katie.reynolds@averylogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick sync: usage uptick + 20-minute live walkthrough

Hi Katie —

Congrats on the recent uptick — I noticed your org just crossed the 100k tokens/day threshold in the last 48 hours after onboarding. Nice work getting things running!

I'm Diego on the SDR team at Redwood. We do short, practical walkthroughs for teams at this stage: 20 minutes to show how the runtime is configured, cover quick cost/latency levers (batching, caching, quant profiles), and answer any immediate questions about data controls. No slide deck fluff — live demo + a short next-steps plan.

Would any of these windows work for a 20-minute session this week?
- Tue 1/17: 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 1/17: 14:00–14:30 PT
- Wed 1/18: 09:00–09:30 PT

If you prefer, grab a slot directly on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/diego-20min

I’m cc’ing Monica (AE) so she can join for questions about rollouts and pricing if helpful. Also attaching a quick one-pager with what we typically cover.

Quick note — if security/compliance is part of the evaluation, mention it in a reply and we’ll have Marcus (solutions engineer) join.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
SDR | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Katie Reynolds <katie.reynolds@averylogistics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@averylogistics.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick sync: usage uptick + 20-minute live walkthrough

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the note and the one-pager. We did hit an uptick after switching more of our document ingestion to batch imports. Appreciate the quick offer.

We'd like the session to cover:
- How Redwood handles long-tail tokens and caching for repeated prompts
- Any immediate cost-saving suggestions (we’re watching the per-token spend closely)
- High-level security posture (SOC 2, data residency options) — procurement asked I copy them in.

Of the times you suggested, Wed 1/18 09:00 PT works best for our team. Could we make it 30 minutes instead of 20? Would appreciate Marcus or an SE on the call for the security part.

Thanks,
Katie
Sr. ML Platform Engineer | Avery Logistics
katie.reynolds@averylogistics.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Katie Reynolds <katie.reynolds@averylogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick sync: usage uptick + 20-minute live walkthrough

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Katie. Wed 1/18 09:00 PT — I'll block 30 minutes. Marcus and Monica are cc'ed and will join for the SE/security and commercial parts.

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min: quick intro + goals
2) 15 min: live walk of your common request pattern + caching/kv behaviors
3) 5 min: security/compliance recap (Marcus)
4) 5 min: next steps & any procurement asks (Monica)

I'll send a calendar invite now. If procurement wants any artifacts in advance, I've attached a short SOC2 readme and an architecture quickview we can walk through.

See you Wed —
Diego
Attachments: soc2-readme.md (text/markdown), architecture-quickview.png (image/png)

Two quick prep items for Marcus: can you pull a single-slide summary of how we usually describe SOC 2 scope for a self-serve account (data at rest/in transit, KMS options, logging retention)? Also attach the architecture quickview to the invite so Katie's procurement team has it ahead of time.

Marcus — if you have a 2–3 minute demo snippet showing KV cache hits vs misses, that'll help make the value tangible in the short slot.

I’ll own the invite and note the deal in HubSpot (HS-42319).
